headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

Below is a quick‑start guide for a few popular IP‑lookup APIs that return **company / organization data** (and often contact details such as email, phone, website, etc.) when you supply an IP address. | Service | Key Features | Free Tier | Typical Endpoint | Example Request | Example Response | |---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|-----------------|------------------| | **ipinfo.io** | • Organization name, ASN, domain
• Company website & logo (paid)
• Email & phone via paid plan | 50k requests/month, 1 k per day | `https://ipinfo.io//json` | `curl https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json?token=YOUR_TOKEN` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","hostname":"dns.google","city":"Mountain View","region":"California","country":"US","loc":"37.3860,-122.0840","org":"AS15169 Google LLC","postal":"94035","timezone":"America/Los_Angeles","readme":"https://ipinfo.io/missingauth"}``` | | **ipapi.co** | • Org name, domain, AS
• Company email & phone (paid)
• Geo‑location | 30k requests/month, 1 k per day | `https://ipapi.co//json/` | `curl https://ipapi.co/8.8.8.8/json/` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","city":"Mountain View","region":"California","country_name":"United States","latitude":37.386,"longitude":-122.0838,"org":"Google LLC","asn":"AS15169","domain":"google.com","postal":"94035","timezone":"America/Los_Angeles","readme":"https://ipapi.co/terms/#usage"}``` | | **ipstack.com** | • Organization, domain, ASN
• Company email & phone (paid)
• Geo‑data | 10k requests/month, 1 k per day | `http://api.ipstack.com/?access_key=YOUR_KEY&format=1` | `curl http://api.ipstack.com/8.8.8.8?access_key=YOUR_KEY&format=1` | ```json{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","type":"ipv4","continent_code":"NA","continent_name":"North America","country_code":"US","country_name":"United States","region_code":"CA","region_name":"California","city":"Mountain View","zip":"94035","latitude":37.386,"longitude":-122.084,"location":{"geoname_id":0,"capital":"Washington D.C.","languages":[{"code":"en","name":"English","native":"English"}],"country_flag":"https://assets.ipstack.com/flags/us.svg","country_flag_emoji":"🇺🇸","calling_code":"1"}}``` | --- ## How to Pick the Right One | Criteria | ipinfo.io | ipapi.co | ipstack.com | |----------|-----------|----------|-------------| | **Free tier limits** | 50k/mo | 30k/mo | 10k/mo | | **Contact info (email/phone)** | Paid only | Paid only | Paid only | | **Geo‑accuracy** | Very good (based on MaxMind) | Good (based on MaxMind) | Good (MaxMind + others) | | **Ease of integration** | Simple JSON, optional CSV | Simple JSON | Simple JSON | | **Rate limiting** | 1 k/day (free) | 1 k/day (free) | 1 k/day (free) | | **Pricing for paid plans** | $50/mo for 500k reqs + extra features | $49/mo for 200k reqs + extra features | $49/mo for 200k reqs + extra features | If you only need *basic* org data (name, ASN, domain) the free tier of any service will do. For *contact* details you’ll need a paid plan – most providers bundle it with higher request limits. --- ## Quick Integration Example (Python) ```python import requests def get_ip_info(ip, api='ipinfo'): """ Fetches IP lookup data from one of the supported services. :param ip: str, e.g., '8.8.8.8' :param api: str, one of 'ipinfo', 'ipapi', 'ipstack' :return: dict, parsed JSON response """ if api == 'ipinfo': url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json" params = {'token': 'YOUR_IPINFO_TOKEN'} # replace with your token elif api == 'ipapi': url = f"https://ipapi.co/{ip}/json/" params = {} # no key needed for free tier elif api == 'ipstack': url = f"http://api.ipstack.com/{ip}" params = {'access_key': 'YOUR_IPSTACK_KEY', 'format': 1} else: raise ValueError("Unsupported API") resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=5) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json() # Example usage if __name__ == "__main__": ip = "8.8.8.8" data = get_ip_info(ip, api='ipinfo') print(data) ``` Replace the placeholder tokens with your own API keys. The function automatically handles query parameters and error checking. --- ## Things to Keep in Mind 1. **Rate Limits** – All free tiers cap at ~1 k requests/day. Exceeding this triggers throttling or temporary bans. 2. **Privacy** – Some jurisdictions restrict sending personal data to third‑party services. Make sure you’re compliant with GDPR, CCPA, etc. 3. **Caching** – IP data rarely changes. Cache responses locally (e.g., Redis, local DB) to reduce API calls and stay within limits. 4. **Data Accuracy** – Geo‑location accuracy depends on the provider’s database. For mission‑critical apps consider a paid plan or a hybrid approach (free tier + local MaxMind DB). 5. **Cost vs. Volume** – If you anticipate >200k requests/month, compare the paid plans: - ipinfo: $50/mo for 500k reqs + extra features - ipapi: $49/mo for 200k reqs + extra features - ipstack: $49/mo for 200k reqs + extra features --- ## Next Steps 1. **Sign up** for a free account on the chosen platform and grab your API key/token. 2. **Test** the endpoint with a tool like `curl` or Postman to confirm you receive the expected fields. 3. **Integrate** into your application using the sample code above. 4. **Cache** the results locally to stay under rate limits. 5. **Upgrade** to a paid plan if you need contact details or higher volume. Happy coding! If you need help setting up caching or handling errors, just let me know.
